title: Let the busywork go.
hint: One connected workflow for your care team
voice: Checking distances, copying visit details, and chasing updates adds up. Bring those steps into one connected workflow.

captions.text:
Checking distances, copying visit
details, and chasing updates adds

up. Bring those steps into one
connected workflow.

title: Your team, on Android.
hint: Browser menu → Add to Home screen → Install
voice: On Android, open OCD Brilliance. Use your browser menu to add the app to your home screen.

captions.text:
On Android, open OCD Brilliance. Use
your browser menu to add the
app to your home screen.

title: Your care, on iPhone.
hint: Safari → Share → Add to Home Screen
voice: On iPhone, open Safari. Choose Share, Add to Home Screen, then Add. Open the icon when it appears.

captions.text:
On iPhone, open Safari. Choose Share,
Add to Home Screen, then Add.
Open the icon when it appears.

title: Request care in seconds.
hint: Choose a service. Pick a time. Send your request.
voice: Clients choose a service and preferred visit time. The request goes straight to the office, with the details already organised.

captions.text:
Clients choose a service and preferred
visit time. The request goes

straight to the office, with the
details already organised.

title: Distance, already worked out.
voice: The proposed route workflow calculates distance and travel time together. Staff review the estimate, instead of measuring each journey manually.

captions.text:
The proposed route workflow calculates
distance and travel time

together. Staff review the estimate,
instead of measuring each
journey manually.

title: Find the right fit faster.
hint: Review skills, availability and travel estimates
voice: The office reviews worker skills, availability, and travel estimates in one view. A staff member approves the visit offer.

captions.text:
The office reviews worker skills,
availability, and travel estimates

in one view. A staff member approves
the visit offer.

title: Everything for the next visit.
hint: Visit details → Accept offer → Plan your day
voice: Employees see the client, service, and travel estimate together. They accept the offer, so the office can confirm the assignment.

captions.text:
Employees see the client, service, and
travel estimate together.

They accept the offer, so the office
can confirm the assignment.

title: A clearer working week.
hint: Visits, calendar and availability in one place
voice: The employee calendar brings upcoming visits together. Availability updates help the office plan without another round of messages.

captions.text:
The employee calendar brings upcoming
visits together. Availability

updates help the office plan without
another round of messages.

title: The update finds you.
hint: A confirmed booking, with the details clients need
voice: Once the office confirms the booking, clients can see the worker, service, and visit time, without calling for an update.

captions.text:
Once the office confirms the booking,
clients can see the worker,

service, and visit time, without
calling for an update.

title: Allow useful updates.
hint: You stay in control of notification permission
voice: When notification permission appears, choose Allow to receive booking updates. The permission choice stays with each person.

captions.text:
When notification permission appears,
choose Allow to receive

booking updates. The permission choice
stays with each person.

title: Confirmed. Noticed. Sorted.
hint: Tap the notification to open the booking
voice: A booking confirmation arrives as a notification. Tap it to open the visit details, with no searching through messages.

captions.text:
A booking confirmation arrives as a
notification. Tap it to open the

visit details, with no searching
through messages.

title: Give time back to care.
hint: Fewer calculations. Fewer follow-ups. Clearer next steps.
voice: Bring route estimates, visit offers, and booking updates into one place. Keep staff in control, and give more time back to care.

captions.text:
Bring route estimates, visit offers,
and booking updates into one

place. Keep staff in control, and give
more time back to care.
